'''Raffid Girard''' was the womanizing son of [[Zacar Girard]]. Alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Raffid seduced at least one married [[House of Thul|Thul]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] before his father was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by unknown means, though his uncle [[Heitor Girard]] suspects Raffid to be the culprit. The hired Bounty Hunter received an offer to kill him and the entire House Girard leadership by [[House Rist]]<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Female Bounty Hunters can romance Raffid. Raffid's fate is determined by the [[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]]. If he is made [[Baron/Legends|Baron]], Raffid can offer the Hunter either the title of Knight or Baroness (depending on the gender and choices). If [[Aitalla Girard|Aitalla]] is made Baroness, she exiles Raffid. Raffid can also be optionally killed if the Hunter allies with [[House Rist]]. He is voiced by [[Troy Hall]].<ref name="TOR" />
